$comment: Single source of truth for uzi UI screenshots: what to capture, how, and where each lands (README vs blog). capture-ui.mjs reads this to shoot both themes; publish-shots.mjs copies the reviewed pairs to each target. Add a row here and it flows to both consumers. themed:true -> a -light.png + -dark.png pair; the README uses <picture>, the blog swaps on html.dark. kind: auto=deterministic route; repo-board=needs --repo (full viewport); run-detail=needs --run + a live state (element capture of one panel); terminal=captured by hand (uzi tui), not this web tool. panel=heading/label text to anchor element capture on (nearest border-edge Card). expand=click this row/label first. requireStatus=the run must be in one of these statuses or the shot is a downgrade (guard skips it). richness=DOM count guard (flag+skip if below min).
denylistComment: Case-insensitive substrings the leak scan flags in the page text before each shot. The instance host (from --url) is added automatically. Extend at runtime with --deny a,b,c.

shots.state: a run parked at the plan-approval gate (use plan-gate-fixture.sh); panel = the 'Plan awaiting your approval' card, not the Run-summary PROPOSED PLAN subsection
any run with a cost breakdown
an in-flight run with a partial milestone checklist
a run whose lead transcript can be expanded
shots.note: NOT PUBLISHED (themed:false, no targets): an EXPANDED transcript leaks real tool-call file paths (github.com+<owner>+<repo>+...) that demo mode does not mask, and runs very tall; a COLLAPSED one just duplicates `activity`. The expand logic works (clicks the lead's aria-expanded group header, falls back to 'Expand all'). Revisit if demo mode masks tool-call paths, then hand-crop a clean region.

`uzi tui` floor view, captured by hand in both themes (light+dark). README uses <picture>; blog uses a Floor/Transcript tabs widget. Not captured or published by the tool — save the PNGs into both image dirs by hand.
`uzi tui` run/transcript view, captured by hand in both themes.
